title: A misspelt function
prompt: The robot tries to print, but the function name is spelt wrong, so Godot cannot find it. Fix the spelling so it prints "Scanning".
hints: Godot only knows functions spelt exactly right.
Compare the name in the error with the real name of the print function.

docs.name: The error panel
docs.what: Godot's message plus the line it happened on, counted from the top of your code.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
